messages:
Anna Park: dropped two alternate comps in Figma: a compact list-first design and a visual cards-first grid. want to decide where token breakdown and invoice CTAs live for org vs project scope. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/billing-redesign
Miguel Santos: looked — personally prefer cards on overview to surface anomalies (spend spikes) visually. list for deep-dive pages.
Jaspreet Kaur: cards are nice but can be noisy on small screens. how would invoice download work on card? top-right CTA? inline kebab?
Anna Park: thought: cards show summary + sparkline + total tokens. a small primary action "View" on card, and a kebab for secondary actions (Download PDF / CSV, Share). list view shows explicit per-row Download button.
Rachel Li: agree. for org view we should avoid putting Download as primary on the card to prevent accidental clicks. Also call out file type: "Download invoice (PDF)" — be explicit in tooltip.
Sam Ortiz: implementation nit: rendering full token rows for every card will be heavy for large orgs. prefer expandable inline drawer that lazy-loads breakdown on open.
Lee Chen: yes — lazy-load token table and cache per project for ~10m. for overview, show only top 2 cost drivers + denom (tokens/usd) to keep cards compact.
Rafael Gomez: dev question: is there existing component for inline drawer or should I build a new one?
Sam Ortiz: we have a popover component but not a full inline drawer. probably better to prototype a lightweight drawer pattern for this flow.
Jaspreet Kaur: copy suggestion: on cards use "View details" not just "View"; kebab actions labelled "Download invoice (PDF)", "Download invoice (CSV)", "Open in Ledger". keeps intent clear.
accessibility-bot: auto audit: ensure expansion has aria-expanded and aria-controls; download links must have descriptive link text; color contrast: light-sparkline (#5AB3FF) fails AA on dark theme.
Rachel Li: thanks bot. propose #7FC7FF for dark sparkline — should pass. also ensure drawer receives focus on open and returns focus on close.
Anna Park: mobile fallback: stack list with compact tokens row. on phones show list by default, cards on tablet+. need design token sizes for compact vs default.
Miguel Santos: performance: when prototype loads a 200-project org, test render time and memory. avoid rendering large DOM for hidden drawers.
Lee Chen: suggest virtualization in list view and encryption-friendly caching for private deployments.
Sam Ortiz: action list: 1) Rafael to prototype inline drawer + kebab actions (lazy-load token API) 2) Jaspreet to update CTA copy variants and tooltips 3) Rachel to add accessibility checklist and alt-color swatches to figma 4) Design to prepare mobile stacked list comps.
Rafael Gomez: I'll spike the drawer and post a branch by Thursday.
Jaspreet Kaur: I'll open a copy PR by EOD Wednesday with both PDF and CSV labels.
Rachel Li: adding a11y checklist now and will ping compliance.
Anna Park: thanks all. quick follow-up — can we also try a compact grid (smaller type, denser tokens) vs the default grid next sync? pairing session Friday morning?
Miguel Santos: Friday am works.
Lee Chen: same.
Anna Park: :thumbsup:
